# ui::testing::OffscreenCapture

Header: `winui/testing/OffscreenCapture.hpp`.

Renders a laid-out [Window](../tree/window.md) to a [Bitmap](../rendering/bitmap.md) with the same renderer an on-screen window uses, with no native window and no GPU. The pixel golden tests capture through it.

Draws into a software bitmap with grayscale text anti-aliasing, so output is stable run to run and independent of the monitor. Lay the window out with [measurer()](#measurer) first so text metrics match what [capture()](#capture) paints. On a platform the library has no renderer for, [ok()](#ok) is false and every capture is an empty bitmap. Not copyable.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::testing::OffscreenCapture d2d;
REQUIRE(d2d.ok());

ui::Window window;
window.set_content(ui::Button{.text = "Hello"});
const ui::Size client{200, 60};
window.layout(client, d2d.measurer());

const ui::Bitmap image = d2d.capture(window, client, ui::Theme::light().colors().background);
REQUIRE(image.width() == 200);
```

## ok

```cpp
bool ok() const
```

True if the renderer was set up and [capture()](#capture) can draw.

## measurer

```cpp
const TextMeasurer& measurer() const
```

The text measurer the renderer uses. Lay the window out with it so text metrics match what [capture()](#capture) paints. Owned by this object; valid for its lifetime.

## capture

```cpp
Bitmap capture(const Window& window, Size client, const Color& background = colors::White)
```

Renders an already laid-out window at `client` pixels (1 DIP == 1 px) to an RGBA image, over `background`. Pass the theme's window background, since Fluent fills are translucent. Returns an empty image if the renderer is not [ok()](#ok).

## capture_changes

```cpp
Bitmap capture_changes(Window& window, Size client, const Color& background = colors::White)
```

[capture()](#capture) the way a window repaints. Over what the last capture of the same size left, only the areas [Window::take_damage()](../tree/window.md#take_damage) reports are cleared and drawn again, and the whole image the first time. A test of the partial repaint checks that the result matches a full [capture()](#capture).
